ns2:section.sectionText: SP22 ENGL286 - This course aims to introduce you to twentieth-century Asian American literature, both short stories and novels, as well as the Asian American experience that shaped those stories. We will look at these authors' portrayal of "the American dream" and what it means to be "American" as defined and experienced by Asian American immigrants, including, but not limited to, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Indian, and Filipino immigrants. There will be two essays, a midterm exam, a final exam, and short writing assignments.
